title: Simple Past Tense
description: Peristiwa dan kebiasaan lampau, was/were, V2, did, used to

lessons.title: Fungsi dan time markers
lessons.body:
# Simple Past Tense — Fungsi
Simple Past digunakan untuk kejadian yang **selesai pada waktu tertentu di masa lalu**, kebiasaan masa lalu, dan rangkaian peristiwa lampau.

- **I visited Bali last week.** — Saya mengunjungi Bali minggu lalu.
- **She was a teacher in 1978.** — Dulu dia seorang guru pada 1978.
- **We often played outside when we were children.** — Kami sering bermain di luar sewaktu kecil.

## Penanda waktu
**Yesterday, last night/week/year, ... ago, in 1998, when I was young.**

Kata *used to + V1* menekankan kebiasaan/keadaan masa lalu yang kini berbeda: **I used to ride a bicycle to school.**

Hindari memakai Present Perfect dengan penanda masa lalu selesai seperti *yesterday*: ❌ *I have visited yesterday* → ✅ *I visited yesterday*.

lessons.title: Kalimat nominal was/were
lessons.body:
# Nominal: was dan were
Gunakan **was/were + adjective, noun, atau keterangan** ketika kalimat tidak memakai kata kerja tindakan utama.

| Subject | Past of be |
|---|---|
| I, he, she, it | was |
| You, we, they | were |

- (+) **They were at home yesterday.**
- (−) **They were not (weren't) at home yesterday.**
- (?) **Were they at home yesterday?**

- (+) **I was tired.** (Saya lelah.)
- (−) **I wasn't tired.**
- (?) **Was I tired?**

**Catatan:** Jangan memakai *did* bersama *was/were* dalam pertanyaan biasa: ❌ *Did she was happy?* → ✅ *Was she happy?*

lessons.title: Verbal V2, did dan pertanyaan
lessons.body:
# Verbal: V2 untuk lampau
- (+) **Subject + V2 + object/complement** — *Rina met her friend yesterday.*
- (−) **Subject + did not + V1** — *Rina did not meet her friend yesterday.*
- (?) **Did + subject + V1 ...?** — *Did Rina meet her friend yesterday?*

**Did** sudah membawa penanda lampau, sehingga kata kerja berikutnya kembali ke **V1**.

❌ *She didn't went.* → ✅ *She didn't go.*

## Regular dan irregular
| V1 | V2 | Arti |
|---|---|---|
| play | played | bermain |
| carry | carried | membawa |
| stop | stopped | berhenti |
| go | went | pergi |
| buy | bought | membeli |
| meet | met | bertemu |

Perubahan *-ed*: **study → studied**, **plan → planned**, **live → lived**. Penggandaan konsonan tidak terjadi pada semua kata yang diakhiri konsonan; perhatikan tekanan suku kata dan pola vokal-konsonan.

title: Present Perfect Tense
description: Have/has + V3; pengalaman dan hasil kini, already/just/yet, since/for

lessons.title: Rumus have/has + V3
lessons.body:
# Present Perfect Tense
Present Perfect menghubungkan **pengalaman/peristiwa lampau dengan keadaan saat ini**, atau periode yang belum berakhir.

| Subject | Auxiliary |
|---|---|
| I, you, we, they | have |
| He, she, it | has |

- (+) **She has finished her homework.**
- (−) **She hasn't finished her homework.**
- (?) **Has she finished her homework?**

Gunakan **V3**: go–went–**gone**, write–wrote–**written**, buy–bought–**bought**.

❌ *He has went* → ✅ *He has gone*.

lessons.title: Already, just, yet, ever, never
lessons.body:
# Penanda waktu Present Perfect
- **already**: *I have already eaten.* (Saya sudah makan.)
- **just**: *She has just arrived.* (Dia baru saja tiba.)
- **yet**: *Have you finished yet?* / *I haven't finished yet.*
- **ever**: *Have you ever visited Japan?*
- **never**: *I have never flown abroad.*

**Present Perfect** bukan pengganti semua bentuk lampau. Jika ada waktu lampau selesai yang spesifik, gunakan Simple Past: *I saw him yesterday*, bukan *I have seen him yesterday*.

lessons.title: Since dan for; been
lessons.body:
# Since vs For
- **since + titik awal** → *since Monday, since 2020, since I was a child*
- **for + durasi** → *for two hours, for five years*

- *I have lived here **for** three years.*
- *I have lived here **since** 2023.*
- *She has **been** busy for two days.*

❌ *I have been sad since two days ago.* → ✅ *I have been sad for two days.* / *I have been sad since Monday.*

Perhatikan konteks keadaan yang masih berlangsung: *have lived* vs *lived* berbeda fokus waktu.

title: Present Continuous Tense
description: Am/is/are + V-ing; aksi berlangsung sekarang dan rencana dekat

lessons.title: Kegunaan dan susunan
lessons.body:
# Present Continuous Tense
Menunjukkan aktivitas yang **sedang berlangsung saat bicara**, situasi sementara, atau rencana masa depan yang sudah diatur.

- *I am reading now.*
- *They are staying at a hotel this week.*
- *We are leaving tomorrow.* (rencana yang sudah dibuat)

**Rumus:** subject + **am/is/are** + V-ing.

- (+) *He is studying English.*
- (−) *He isn't studying English.*
- (?) *Is he studying English?*

❌ *She studying* → ✅ *She is studying*.

lessons.title: Spelling rules -ing
lessons.body:
# Membentuk V-ing
| V1 | -ing |
|---|---|
| write | writing |
| make | making |
| stop | stopping |
| sit | sitting |
| die | dying |
| lie | lying |
| carry | carrying |
| see | seeing |

**Perhatikan:** *hope → hoping*, bukan *hoping* = *hopping* (dari *hop*). Pada kata tertentu, konsonan terakhir digandakan karena pola suku kata dan tekanan, tidak otomatis untuk semua konsonan.

Contoh: *She is writing a letter now.*

lessons.title: Stative verbs dan pengecualian
lessons.body:
# Stative verbs
Kata kerja yang menyatakan keadaan, kepemilikan, atau pendapat **biasanya** memakai Simple Present alih-alih Continuous.

- *I know the answer.* bukan biasanya *I am knowing the answer*.
- *She owns a car.* bukan *She is owning a car*.
- *I like coffee.* bukan biasanya *I am liking coffee*.

**Pengecualian bergantung makna:**
- *I **have** a car.* (memiliki) vs *I **am having** dinner.* (makan malam)
- *I **think** she is right.* (berpendapat) vs *I **am thinking** about the problem.* (sedang mempertimbangkan)
- *He **looks** tired.* vs *He **is looking** at the screen.*

Jadi kata-kata dalam daftar modul cetak tidak semuanya *selalu* terlarang dalam bentuk Continuous.

title: Past Continuous Tense
description: Was/were + V-ing; aksi sedang berlangsung di masa lalu, when/while

lessons.title: Rumus dan bentuk kalimat
lessons.body:
# Past Continuous Tense
Gunakan **was/were + V-ing** untuk tindakan yang sedang berlangsung pada suatu waktu di masa lalu.

- (+) *She was reading at 9 p.m. last night.*
- (−) *She wasn't reading at 9 p.m. last night.*
- (?) *Was she reading at 9 p.m. last night?*

**I/he/she/it + was**; **you/we/they + were**.

*We were having dinner when he called.* — Kami sedang makan malam ketika dia menelepon.

lessons.title: When dan while
lessons.body:
# When vs While
**While** sering memperkenalkan aktivitas yang sedang berlangsung, sedangkan **when** dapat memperkenalkan kejadian yang menyela atau titik waktu.

- *I **was studying** when the phone **rang**.*
- *While she **was cooking**, her husband **was cleaning**.*
- *They **were talking** when the concert **began**.*

Kedua kata tidak otomatis menentukan tense; yang penting ialah durasi/peran kejadian.

❌ *When I was study, she called.* → ✅ *When I was studying, she called.*

lessons.title: Membedakan Past dan Past Continuous
lessons.body:
# Simple Past vs Past Continuous
- **Simple Past**: kejadian selesai → *The phone rang.*
- **Past Continuous**: aktivitas sedang berlangsung pada saat lampau → *I was sleeping.*

Gabungan: *I was sleeping when the phone rang.*

**Kuis latihan:**
1. *At 8 p.m. yesterday, they ___ (watch) TV.* → **were watching**.
2. *She ___ (cook) when I arrived.* → **was cooking**.
3. *While I was reading, my brother ___ (play) games.* → **was playing**.

**Catatan kurikulum:** sebagian dialog perjalanan dalam fotomu memakai Simple Past, bukan Past Continuous. Di LMS contoh-contoh dipisahkan menurut tense yang sebenarnya.

title: Simple Future Tense
description: Will dan be going to; prediksi, janji, keputusan, rencana

lessons.title: Future with will
lessons.body:
# Future with Will
**Will + V1** dipakai untuk prediksi, keputusan spontan, tawaran, janji dan peristiwa masa depan.

- (+) *I will call you tomorrow.*
- (−) *I won't call you tomorrow.*
- (?) *Will you call me tomorrow?*

Setelah *will* gunakan **V1**, bukan V2 atau -ing: ❌ *will goes* → ✅ *will go*.

Nominal: *She will be ready tomorrow.*

lessons.title: Be going to
lessons.body:
# Future: be going to
Sering digunakan untuk **niat/rencana** yang sudah dipikirkan atau prediksi dengan bukti saat ini.

- (+) *We are going to visit Bali next month.*
- (−) *We aren't going to visit Bali next month.*
- (?) *Are we going to visit Bali next month?*

Nominal: *He is going to be a doctor.*

❌ *We are not going work* → ✅ *We are not going to work*.

**Will** dan **going to** kadang sama-sama benar; makna dan konteks menentukan pilihan.

lessons.title: Will vs going to vs Present Continuous
lessons.body:
# Memilih bentuk masa depan
| Fungsi | Contoh |
|---|---|
| Keputusan saat berbicara | *I will open the door.* |
| Rencana yang sudah dibuat | *I am going to study tonight.* |
| Janji | *I will help you.* |
| Bukti kuat | *Look at those clouds! It is going to rain.* |
| Jadwal pribadi yang sudah diatur | *I am meeting her on Friday.* |

Penanda waktu: *tomorrow, next week, soon, tonight*. Penanda saja tidak menentukan satu tense mutlak; lihat konteks.

title: Future Continuous Tense
description: Will be + V-ing untuk kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung nanti

lessons.title: Will be + V-ing
lessons.body:
# Future Continuous Tense
Menjelaskan aktivitas yang **akan sedang berlangsung pada suatu waktu di masa depan**.

- (+) *At 8 p.m. tomorrow, I will be studying.*
- (−) *I will not be studying at 8 p.m.*
- (?) *Will you be studying at 8 p.m.?*

Rumus: **Subject + will + be + V-ing**.

Perhatikan **be** tidak boleh hilang: ❌ *I will studying* → ✅ *I will be studying*.

lessons.title: Penggunaan Future Continuous
lessons.body:
# Kapan digunakan?
- Aktivitas yang berlangsung pada titik waktu masa depan: *This time tomorrow, we will be flying to Jakarta.*
- Peristiwa terjadwal atau yang diharapkan berjalan: *Will you be using the computer tonight?*
- Dua kegiatan: *When you arrive, I will be waiting for you.*

Tanda waktu: **this time tomorrow, at 9 tonight, when you arrive**.

Jangan memakai *will* dalam anak kalimat waktu biasa dengan *when*: ✅ *when you arrive*, bukan biasanya *when you will arrive*.

lessons.title: Future Continuous vs Simple Future
lessons.body:
# Future Continuous vs Simple Future
- **I will call you at 8.** → Saya akan meneleponmu pukul 8 (kejadian).
- **I will be calling clients at 8.** → Pada pukul 8, saya akan sedang menelepon klien (aktivitas yang berlangsung).

- **They will travel tomorrow.** → Mereka akan bepergian besok.
- **They will be travelling this time tomorrow.** → Pada waktu seperti ini besok mereka akan sedang dalam perjalanan.

Latih keduanya melalui soal pilihan ganda dan terjemahan bertahap.

title: Modal Auxiliary Verbs
description: Can, could, may, must, should, would, will, shall dan must not

lessons.title: Can dan Could
lessons.body:
# Can dan Could
**Can + V1** = kemampuan/izin/permintaan.
- *She can swim.*
- *Can I use your pen?*

**Could + V1** = kemampuan lampau atau permintaan yang lebih sopan.
- *When I was five, I could swim.*
- *Could you help me, please?*

Tidak menambahkan **to** setelah modal biasa: ❌ *can to swim* → ✅ *can swim*.

lessons.title: Must, have to, must not dan should
lessons.body:
# Kewajiban, larangan, nasihat
- **must** = kewajiban/keharusan: *You must wear a helmet.*
- **must not / mustn't** = larangan: *You mustn't park here.*
- **don't have to** = tidak wajib: *You don't have to come early.*
- **should** = nasihat: *You should study more.*

Penting: **mustn't** ≠ **don't have to**.

*Must* juga menyatakan kesimpulan kuat: *She must be tired.*

lessons.title: May, Would, Will dan Shall
lessons.body:
# Izin dan permintaan sopan
- *May I come in?* (izin formal)
- *Would you open the window, please?* (permintaan sopan)
- *Will you help me?* (permintaan)
- *Shall we begin?* (usulan, sering dengan *we*)
- *I would like to join the club.* (keinginan sopan)

**Should** bukan sekadar bentuk lampau dari *shall*, dan **would** bukan selalu bentuk lampau dari *will*; fungsinya lebih luas.

Formula umum: (+) **S + modal + V1**; (−) **S + modal + not + V1**; (?) **Modal + S + V1?**

title: Passive Voice
description: Be + V3 pada present, past, perfect, future dan modal

lessons.title: Active vs Passive
lessons.body:
# Passive Voice
Pada Passive Voice, yang menjadi subjek ialah pihak/benda yang **menerima** tindakan.

**Pola:** subject + **be** (sesuai tense) + **V3** (+ by + agent, bila penting).

- Active: *The teacher cleaned the board.*
- Passive: *The board was cleaned by the teacher.*

Tidak selalu perlu *by*: *My wallet was stolen.*

Gunakan bentuk yang mengikuti waktu tindakan, tidak selalu *is* atau *was*.

lessons.title: Passive dalam berbagai tenses
lessons.body:
# Bentuk Passive menurut tense
| Tense | Rumus | Contoh |
|---|---|---|
| Simple Present | am/is/are + V3 | *The room is cleaned daily.* |
| Simple Past | was/were + V3 | *The door was closed yesterday.* |
| Present Perfect | have/has been + V3 | *The letters have been sent.* |
| Simple Future | will be + V3 | *The report will be published.* |
| Modal | modal + be + V3 | *The stain must be cleaned.* |
| Present Continuous | am/is/are being + V3 | *The road is being repaired.* |

❌ *The door will closed* → ✅ *The door will be closed.*

lessons.title: Passive dalam instruksi dan terjemahan
lessons.body:
# Terjemahan dan pemilihan struktur Passive
- *Pintu itu harus tetap tertutup.* → **The door must be kept closed.**
- *Pengumuman ini harus ditempel.* → **This announcement must be posted.**
- *Paspor ini ditemukan di bawah meja.* → **This passport was found under the table.**
- *Kue itu terbuat dari tepung dan gula.* → **The cake is made from flour and sugar.**

**Ingat:** *founded* berarti 'mendirikan', bukan bentuk V3 dari *find*. Bentuknya *find–found–found*.

Tidak semua kalimat Indonesia yang memiliki 'di-' cocok diterjemahkan secara pasif dalam konteks bahasa Inggris; pahami fokus kalimatnya.
